humdrumCorrections.basis: Source token correction with print reference: 025-1b-LE-009.krn line 269 (bar 21, under 8va) encodes the second staccato octave of the first half-bar as `16edee-'>JJ` / `16dee-`, which contain two pitch names each and are not valid **kern pitches; read as E-flat7/E-flat6 (`16eeee-` / `16eee-`). Print, viewed 19 Oct 2026 in OCVE page images: the French first edition (25-1a-Sm, M. Schlesinger, plate M.S. 2427, p. 32, bar 21; https://chopinonline.ac.uk/ocve/browse/pageview/75382/) and the English first edition (25/7-12-1b-W, Wessel, plate W & Co No. 1833, p. 6, bar 21; https://chopinonline.ac.uk/ocve/browse/pageview/77282/) both engrave this staccato octave one staff step below the preceding accented F-flat octave (encoded `16ffff-X` / `16fff-X`, line 267), with no accidental: E, flat by the G-flat-major key signature. The encoding's other half-bars of the sequence step down the same way (lines 273/275 C-flat7/C-flat6 then B-flat6/B-flat5; 280/282 E-double-flat7 then D-flat7; 286/288 B-double-flat6 then A-flat6). Verovio 6.3.0 reads the malformed tokens as E and D. The downloaded bytes are unchanged; the correction is applied in memory and retained in the check report.
